marking: DEMO/SIMULATION — trained on synthetic data generated by ai/data/generate.py
limitations: Trained exclusively on synthetic data; metrics do not predict field performance.
No real agricultural telemetry, imagery, or fraud labels were used.
Intended to demonstrate the complete AI workflow, not to be deployed as-is.

Training and validation images come from the same procedural generator, so a high or even perfect validation score measures separability of the synthetic classes, not generalisation to photographs of real leaves.

The --fast training path (6 epochs, 90 images per class) undertrains the vision model and confuses LEAF_BLIGHT with RUST, whose synthetic textures differ only in lesion scale. Use the default path for any reported figure.
model: IsolationForest novelty component over event features
note: Rules dominate the score; the model contributes a novelty term only (ADR-012)
